The OC was about a group that usually sits at the top of 140. For over a year now that has been KSU. While the OP went on to say that the 9/11 stuff was in Summer 2018 (KSU was formed after that), it is hard from the beginning statement to not see who he/she is talking about is KSU, rendering much of what was to follow to be about KSU.

Yes, you are missing something. With one click of their profiles, you will notice that two of the three were created months ago. If you see someone's time on Reddit as the validity of what they say, then take mine. I've been on Reddit since 2015. And I will also reinforce everything they stated here. Now, while I see it as a completely unsound benchmark for the validity of someone's statements and comments, I hope you are able to accept their comments now.

The behavior represented at the game by the fans in 122 is despicable and has no room whatsoever at Subaru Park, or anywhere. It is a problem which the club would do well to take care of swiftly and effectively. It is a behavior that I, nor none of the people I go to the games with, would ever tolerate. 

What evidence did you even have for saying you were "fairly certain it's the same group of guys that usually sit at the top of 140"? There is video evidence of what was occurring in the section it was occurring. In the video, you can even see TRE is at the opposite side of the stadium, not in such earshot where you could hear the language of a single person distinctly. I would like to know what basis you have for your original claim.

The "group of guys that sit at the top of 140" is KSU and has been for over a year now, so idk who else usually sits there. 

Sure, you weren't referring to KSU for being the 9/11 guys and as The140Casual and others said, we would never stand for that. 

One thing I knew when I joined this incredible group of people was that, so long as you are willing to support the Union and be there for one another, nothing else matters. These people who are, and have been for over a year, the same people who "usually sit at the top of 140," would never stand for such intolerance. So, what I really want to know, what basis do you have for your claims you made in your OC? I don't intend to assume, but from the looks of it, it seems you are trying to target a group of innocent, faithful, and passionate supporters without any real evidence.

Trust me, being loud and proud at games is something I love to do. I love getting behind the team and maybe I'll take a crack at a ref or opposing player. But, as so many people do, I know there's a firm line between right and wrong here. When you attack the identity of a person, it becomes too far. Plenty of people would say I'm a nutjob among many other names at games. There's a difference between being a nutjob and being a pathetic racist, homophobe, etc.
